statement: A break-glass revoke of a binding that still grants takes the document's staging slot whatever change holds it; the holder becomes CONFLICTED. A revoke of a binding that still grants is taken from the slot only by another such revoke, and revoking the binding again publishes a READY revoke of it that stalled. A revoke of an expired binding waits like any change, and any change that may preempt takes its slot.
